authorization_reference: User: Launch training. Consecutive in-scope scratch experiments under program.md.
selection_rule: Final fresh C3 U-Net192 FM25 40k EMA FID must be lower than S3 consistency-only final40k on both paired selection seeds, separately per NFE.
confirmation_rule: For each eligible NFE, final C3 40k EMA FID must be lower than S3 final40k on all four paired confirmation seeds; otherwise inconclusive.
training_time_rationale: All40000 fresh updates at measured 2.950454434 seconds/update give 32.782827045 optimizer hours. Match S3 exposure and full curriculum to isolate objective allocation: S3 last10k improved both tracks, so a shorter changing-curriculum proxy cannot settle the final comparison. A longer mixture run would confound horizon before local evidence. The 38h watchdog rounds up the slowest measured mean/last-half/terminal projection (32.954825469h), 8% timing/recovery margin, twice S3 non-update overhead (1.597140121h), and60s shutdown. The full40k horizon never extends.
evaluation_time_rationale: At most32 full passes:12 S3 references and20 C3 candidates. Use slowest S3 full passes by NFE ({'1': 50.628866605460644, '4': 109.57534893415868}), C3 slowest qualified95-batch generation ({'1': 20.196620812639594, '4': 78.22712067514658}), and1.5 times the largest S3 full-pass minus qualified-generation estimate (31.671748s) per candidate as an overhead proxy, plus60s startup. Raw 2955.615161s, plus20% margin and round up to 3600s. Includes bounded recovery; this is not pure inference latency.
microbatch_rationale: Keep16 at effective batch128, with32 FM and96 consistency examples per update. Full augmentation, accumulation, optimizer and EMA were active. No performance sweep. The only qualification retry corrected a bitwise test; all failed-contract, diagnosis and retry costs remain charged under the original1200s qualification cap. All qualification states are discarded.
initialization_evidence: Qualification saved no generative checkpoint. Fresh production directory; no starting checkpoint. Model, optimizer, EMA, RNG and data initialize at zero with the complete40000-step horizon.
interpretation_rule: Generation-seed confirmation from one scratch training seed is not training-seed replication. Marginal or conflicting changes remain inconclusive for further scaling; no added seeds until a desired outcome appears.
next_decision: A substantive confirmed gain promotes the relevant track and motivates fresh replication or a refined mix. A negative/inconclusive result keeps S3 and redirects to time coverage or a fresh equal-compute recipe; no automatic mixture or horizon increase.
changed_factor: 25% direct-conditioned flow-matching /75% consistency batch allocation; no guidance, auxiliary network or pretrained generative weights.
recipe: First32 examples of each shuffled batch128 use FM at sigmoid(N(-.9,1.6^2)), t>=1e-4; remaining96 use unchanged consistency. Per-example1/128 gradient weight, no extra lambda. Full40k exponential gap1 to1/3200, 1e-4 floor, p=.75 eps=.001, upstream augmentation with matching consistency-branch metadata; fixed RAdam1e-4, EMA warmup from0 cap.9999; seed42 and fresh data state.
comparison_limitation: Matches architecture, effective batch, microbatch, total presentations, optimizer/EMA and full consistency schedule. Objective allocation changes RNG consumption and consistency presentations; compute is measured, not matched. One fresh training seed, reused development data and generation-seed confirmation only.
